questions.question: Human Adenovirus species C (e.g., HAdV-C2 and HAdV-C5) utilizes a two-step receptor interaction model for cell entry. Which statement accurately describes this entry mechanism?
options: The fiber knob binds the Coxsackievirus and Adenovirus Receptor (CAR) for primary attachment, followed by penton base RGD motif interaction with alpha-v integrins to trigger endocytosis.
The hexon protein binds directly to CD4, followed by fiber knob interaction with CXCR4 to mediate direct membrane fusion at the cell surface.
The penton base binds cell surface sialic acid, followed by hexon protein interaction with heparin sulfate proteoglycans for caveolin-mediated endocytosis.
The fiber knob binds low-density lipoprotein receptor (LDLR), followed by penton base interaction with clathrin light chains to initiate macropinocytosis.

questions.question: During the lysogenic cycle of Bacteriophage lambda, which viral protein functions as a homodimeric transcriptional repressor that shuts down lytic gene expression and confers immunity against superinfection?
options: Cro protein
cI repressor
cII protein
N antiterminator

questions.question: Coronaviruses synthesize a nested set of subgenomic mRNAs (sgmRNAs) to express their structural and accessory proteins. What molecular mechanism drives this process?
options: Polymerase jumping during positive-strand mRNA synthesis triggered by internal poly(A) tracts.
Host spliceosome-mediated alternative splicing of a single full-length pre-genomic RNA transcript.
Discontinuous transcription during negative-strand synthesis mediated by base-pairing between body and leader Transcription-Regulating Sequences (TRSs).
Proteolytic cleavage of a giant polyprotein precursor by the viral main protease at conserved cleavage sites.

questions.question: Severe manifestations of Dengue virus infection, such as Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF), are frequently associated with Antibody-Dependent Enhancement (ADE) during secondary infection. What is the precise mechanism responsible for ADE?
options: Cross-reactive IgA antibodies bind vascular endothelial cadherin, directly disrupting endothelial tight junctions.
Complement activation by viral NS1 antigen forms membrane attack complexes on host erythrocyte membranes.
Autoreactive cytotoxic T lymphocytes target uninfected bystander cells displaying viral envelope epitopes.
Pre-existing, weakly neutralizing heterologous IgG antibodies cross-link viral virions to Fc gamma receptors (FcγR) on myeloid cells, increasing viral uptake and replication.

questions.question: During Ebola virus entry into host endosomes, the viral surface glycoprotein (GP1,2) must be cleaved by host endosomal proteases to expose its receptor-binding domain. Which endosomal enzymes perform this processing, and to which host intracellular receptor does the cleaved GP subsequently bind?
options: Furin and Factor Xa; binding to Scavenger Receptor A
TMPRSS2 and Matriptase; binding to Neuropilin-1
Cathepsins B and L; binding to Niemann-Pick C1 (NPC1)
Trypsin and Elastase; binding to DC-SIGN
